deadline.value: Complete applications (with all documents) are due Monday, January 25, 2027 for September 2027 entry; the portal opens November 12, 2026. Applying early improves scholarship consideration.
deadline.quote: completed applications with all supporting documents have to be submitted by Monday, January 25th, 2027 for both domestic and international applicants.

gre_subject.value: No standardized test is required other than English proficiency.
gre_subject.quote: No (other than a passing English proficiency score)

supervisor.value: You must be accepted by a faculty member who agrees to supervise and fund you; contact prospective supervisors after applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants to the graduate program must be accepted by a faculty member who agrees to supervise and fund the student’s research. | only applicants with support of a potential supervisor in the Department will be admitted into the program.

funding.value: PhD students in the funded cohort get about CAD 31,500 plus tuition and fees a year (international students also get health insurance), for 4 years after an MSc or 5 years direct from a BSc.
funding.quote: approximately $31,500 plus tuition and fees for Ph.D. students | International Ph.D. students receive the same base stipend plus UHIP health insurance

entry_route.value: International applicants can only apply to the PhD: after an MSc (A- average) or directly from a BSc with an A- average. International MSc applications are not considered.
entry_route.quote: Following completion of an MSc: Applicants applying from an MSc degree program or equivalent from a recognized university must have an average of A- in their MSc program. | Direct entry from BSc: Students with an exceptional record in a BSc program (minimally, University of Toronto A- average or equivalent) may apply to be considered for direct admission into the PhD program. | the department does not consider international MSc applications for admission

notes: Ecology & Evolutionary Biology (EEB) is a separate PhD program (international deadline 8 Dec 2025 in the last cycle; supervisor needed before admission).
